item.title: How Does a Recommendation Model Benefit from Reasoning?
item.author: mycaptainmy@gmail.com (Yuan Meng)
item.description: I got a baffling message from a friend one night, saying “Don’t go to this restaurant!” and found out she went to a new restaurant recommended by a Xiaohongshu post that I forwarded to her, which turned out to be terrible. “Oh, I wasn’t recommending it to you.” So I explained. “Then was your intent?” She asked. “I was randomly browsing my feed before bed and forwarded the first new place I saw, without a thought.” “Oh well, I was a reasoning model that made up all this intent.” So she joked.
